why: No major reviewer or authority addresses HYROX at all; TechRadar and Tom's Guide pages are general fitness-tracker and running-watch guides answering a neighbouring question. The HYROX-specific results are small niche sites (roxskin, hyroxinsider, hyroxvegas) that give budget picks with specs but no testing anyone can check, one unreadable, and one hyroxfitness page pitched at a $450+ price band. A focused budget HYROX watch page with current prices, race-mode availability by model and a direct pick would stand out.
